results.title: I Think My Neighbors Are Starting a Cult (A Wormtown Story)
results.original_title: I Think My Neighbors Are Starting a Cult (A Wormtown Story)
results.overview: Set in the world of WORMTOWN, "I Think My Neighbors Are Starting a Cult" follows Emma, a small town content creator whose posts evolve from local business reviews to disturbing chronicles of her neighbors joining what appears to be a parasitic worm cult. Over eight months, Emma's documentation spirals from curiosity to paranoia as the series blurs fiction and reality.

results.title: Somang
results.overview: After Steve, a queer Korean American teenager, discovers his deceased grandfather was queer but kept it secret, he discovers his grandfather's activist past and his mission to protect Steve from the hatred he faced. In deciding to keep this a secret, it tore their family apart. Now, armed with this newfound understanding, Steve must reconcile his family's fractured relationships and embrace his own identity to bring them back together.

results.title: Dear Ms.: A Revolution in Print
results.original_title: Dear Ms.: A Revolution in Print
results.overview: Three filmmakers dive deep into the storied and complex legacy of Ms. magazine through the lens of some of its most iconic covers, featuring never-before-seen archival footage and engaging interviews with the powerful women who shaped the magazine at its inception over fifty years ago

results.title: Friidrottsfeber – Hjältarna som tände en nation
results.original_title: Friidrottsfeber – Hjältarna som tände en nation
results.overview: Athens 2004. Gold is within reach. Two missed jumps, and all of Sweden holds its breath. The 2000s saw an unprecedented golden age for Swedish athletics. Stars like Carolina Klüft, Stefan Holm, and Kajsa Bergqvist achieved hero status. Relive the goosebumps from the road to that Swedish gold rush in this short documentary.

results.title: Chelsea Zurflüh & Jonathan Tetelman @ Château de Neuschwanstein 2025
results.original_title: Chelsea Zurflüh & Jonathan Tetelman Château de Neuschwanstein 2025
results.overview: Accompanied by the chamber music ensemble CHAARTS, the soprano and tenor perform arias and duets from works by Mozart, Verdi, Puccini, Gounod, and Bizet.  All in the open air, in the courtyard of Neuschwanstein Castle.

results.title: Gamophobia
results.overview: Marja always has a fear of starting a serious relationship. As a friend, Gupa always gives advice to Marja, even though he is still single. Marja and Kirina are ex-girlfriends who meet again. Their relationship always fails, Kirina thinks this is because of her actions. They agree to find the whereabouts of the Shaman and the Doll that Kirina used to come to play a trick on Marja. Their efforts fail. Marja's love for Kirina grows again, but it's too late.

results.title: Terry McMillan Presents: His, Hers & Ours
results.original_title: Terry McMillan Presents: His, Hers & Ours
results.overview: Forced to spend time together due to their teenage children’s relationship, a secret romance between Darius and Kelly blossoms, stealing moments at family gatherings and behind closed doors.

results.title: Jebus
results.overview: A divine comedy about a beach bum named Jebus returning to teach America how to love during politically divisive times. A satirical second coming mocking political and religious hypocrisy.

results.title: Christmas in Midnight Clear
results.overview: Hillary Shaw, a successful corporate real estate developer, arrives in the economically struggling town with decisive plans to acquire every possible property, declare the rest eminent domain, and to modernize the town from the inside out. But when Hillary encounters Daniel Porter, local pastor and multi-generational pillar of the community, her vision faces more than legal challenges. As Hillary and Daniel’s worldviews spark conflict, something deeper begins to blossom.

results.title: The Treasure of Barracuda
results.overview: Captain Barracuda is obsessed with finding Phineas Crane’s treasure, the most valuable and sought after by all the pirates of the Caribbean. To achieve this, he will need the help of Sparks, a girl who pretends to be a boy in order to survive among the savage members of the Barracuda crew. Finding a Phineas Crane memoir will be the key to reaching the long-awaited treasure and also Sparks’ lifeline, since she is the only one who can read on the ship and, therefore, the only one capable of deciphering that “Letter map” that the found manuscript supposes.
